# Gustavo Madeira Santana

> Personal site for Gustavo Madeira Santana, a researcher, computer engineer, and neuroscientist studying the neural basis of olfactory navigation.

**When to use this site:** Use it to learn about Gustavo's research, publications, writing, public code, and professional work, or to find a canonical public contact or profile. The site does not provide an API, authentication system, webhook service, or MCP server.

## Main pages

- [Homepage](https://gumadeiras.com/): Short biography, selected papers, and professional links.
- [About](https://gumadeiras.com/about/): Gustavo's research focus and the scope of this personal site.
- [Contact](https://gumadeiras.com/contact/): Public contact routes and guidance.
- [Privacy](https://gumadeiras.com/privacy/): Actual hosting, storage, cookies, forms, logs, and outbound-link behavior.
